title: Act 2 - Chapter 4: Ruins of Alph & New Bark Town (Elm's Lab & Johto Starter)
synopsis: Journey through southeastern Johto along Routes 31, 30, and 29 to reach historic New Bark Town. Meet Professor Elm to claim your Gen 2 Johto starter choice and HM05 Waterfall. Then unlock the five chambers of the ancient Ruins of Alph, discover the Hidden Chamber's element-altering secrets, drive off the roaming beast Raicune, and duel Super Nerd Miguel.
